module: Flowgraph node "Directional Gravity" (category dynamic_p_duration, vehicle color/icon). Gives a vehicle directional gravity by simulating a huge, very distant planet: places a "planet" of radius 1,000,000 m at 1,000,000 m from the vehicle in the given direction, with the mass that produces the desired acceleration (mass = magnitude * radius² / G), via obj:setPlanets on the vehicle side. Inputs: vehId (number, otherwise player vehicle), direction (vec3, normalized by the node, default {0,0,-1}), magnitude (m/s², default 1). When the graph stops, the vehicle's planets are removed (obj:setPlanets({})). In 'repeat' mode, recomputed every frame (useful because the origin follows the vehicle).
notes: Bug (editor): drawMiddle reads self.pinIn.mass and self.pinIn.radius which do not exist on this node (copied from Planet): causes a nil indexing error when drawing.
data.showDebug (true by default) draws a line and the gravity force (text) in the world from drawMiddle.

init.desc: Enables showDebug and creates the planet table.

work.desc: If dynamicMode is 'repeat', reapplies the gravity every frame.

setDirectionalGravity.desc: Computes the planet's origin, radius and mass and sends obj:setPlanets to the vehicle. Does nothing if direction or magnitude is nil.

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: debug display (line, force) and surface gravity.
